environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed with API Gateway (REST API) fronted by a CloudFront distribution. The CloudWatch Log Group has a subscription filter that routes to a Kinesis Firehose with a Lambda transformation function applying OWASP log encoding (replacing CR/LF/tab and HTML metacharacters) before delivery to the SIEM. Additionally, the CloudFront distribution enforces a response headers policy (ID: 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03) that sets Require-SRI-For directive and strict CSP with require-sri-for notation. The API Gateway has a request validator (ValidateBody+QueryString) with a JSON schema that constrains the 'username' parameter to ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.\s]{1,64}$ regex pattern, rejecting any request where username contains newlines, angle brackets, or control characters before the Lambda is even invoked.

config.request_validator: ValidateBody+QueryString with JSON schema regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.\s]{1,64}$ on username param
config.log_transformation: Kinesis Firehose Lambda transformer applying OWASP log encoding (CR/LF/HTML metachar replacement)
config.siem_rendering: Splunk dashboard with encoded field display
config.cdn_integrity: SRI enforced via CSP require-sri-for script style
